name: Eulerian TacJS
description: Registers the Eulerian analytics service with the TacJS (Tarte au Citron) consent manager so the Eulerian tag loads according to visitor consent.
project_description: Eulerian TacJS is a small bridge module that registers the Eulerian analytics/marketing tag as a service inside the TacJS (Tarte au Citron) consent manager. It declares the Eulerian service definition through hook_tacjs_content_alter() and, in hook_page_attachments_alter(), swaps the Eulerian module's default init library for a consent-aware loader so the Eulerian tag fires either after the visitor consents (mandatory-consent mode, via tarteaucitron.js) or immediately (consent-exempt mode). It has no routes, permissions, forms or settings of its own; the Eulerian account/collect domain and datalayer are configured in the Eulerian module and consent behaviour is toggled on the TacJS service configuration page. Requires the Eulerian and TacJS contrib modules.
